author: HotAndCrunch
body:
So I've been thinking that having a team rank in game, on the forums and on ts would be very helpful. Firstly, in game everyone, including myself is asked "what team are you on" i do not mind this, but it does get a little repetitive. The way I would have it is that when you say something in game it shows up like this:
[team tag/ full team name]:[player name]: message 
For example:
BEAR: HotAndCrunch: hello
Or
Apollo: HotAndCrunch: hello

Secondly on teamspeak. This tag would be really helpful, as you could join your team channel without having to enter the password (I'm no ts expert but I'm pretty sure there will still be a way to invite others into your teamspeak channel). Entering the password can get very annoying. Especially when someone finds out what it is so you have to change it. 
It would also be cool if the team leaders could upload a "team logo" to act as the real on ts. 

Another team related suggestion would be to have a team chat in game. (team as in tournament team)

This thing isn't 100% needed but I think it would be  nice to see.  Leave your opinions

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
I'd like to say first that ranks in general run off of priority, an example is ofc admin has the highest priority and would come first so it appears in-game over all the other ranks the person may have. What I'm getting at is I don't believe this is possible (if it is Developers prove me wrong) but just like tourney ranks for example, since they have less priority than any other rank, if you have say gold rank then you wouldn't be able to see said team tag. These team names would only show if you have no donor rank or any rank so I don't see this being needed really. Also like Eric and Snow said, it would just clutter chat and can easily be abused. 

Next regarding Teamspeak permissions, this is not possible to let you join your channel without password needed unless you have a staff rank. Newcleus can probably explain this better but it also works almost the same as in-game ranks. One rank has the highest priority and ones under it go down. Team channel join power is much lower than suites and staff channels so no random people can join. Same with people who can join suites can't staff channels or team channels without a password. So if we were to do this rank idea like you said, then we would have to give each rank the same join power which wouldn't work b/c people would be able to join all team channels. No real way to make this work without a password or switch from Teamspeak to Mumble.
